s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing or using SALA (Room Management System), you agree to these Terms of Service.

s2.title: 2. Service Description
s2.body: SALA is an institutional platform for room booking, equipment management, approval workflows, incidents and notifications.

s3.title: 3. Accounts and Access
s3.body: Access is via Google authentication (OAuth). You are responsible for your institutional account security.

s4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
s4.body: You may not use the system for unlawful purposes, access other organizations' data, or disrupt platform operation.

s5.title: 5. Reservations and Approvals
s5.body: Reservations may require admin approval. Your institution defines space usage rules; SALA records requests and decisions.

s6.title: 6. Availability
s6.body: We strive for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. Maintenance may occur without notice.

s7.title: 7. Intellectual Property
s7.body: SALA software, brand and interface belong to the project owners. User-provided content remains each organization's responsibility.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
s8.body: SALA is provided as is within legal limits. We are not liable for indirect damages from use or inability to use the service.

s9.title: 9. Changes
s9.body: We may update these terms. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.body: Questions about these terms should be directed to your organization administrator or institutional SALA support.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.body: This policy describes how SALA handles personal data in accordance with GDPR/LGPD and privacy best practices.

s2.title: 2. Data Collected
s2.body: We collect name, email, profile photo (when available via Google), organization, reservations, incidents and usage logs.

s3.title: 3. Purpose
s3.body: Data is used for authentication, room and reservation management, notifications, security, support and service improvement.

s4.title: 4. Legal Basis
s4.body: Processing is based on contract or institutional policy, legitimate interest and consent where applicable.

s5.title: 5. Sharing
s5.body: Data may be processed by infrastructure providers (hosting, database, email/push) under appropriate security measures.

s6.title: 6. Retention
s6.body: We retain data as needed for described purposes and legal obligations.

s7.title: 7. Data Subject Rights
s7.body: You may request access, correction, deletion and portability through your organization administrator.

s8.title: 8. Security
s8.body: We adopt technical and organizational measures including access control and encryption in transit.

s9.title: 9. Cookies and Session
s9.body: We use session cookies for authentication. We do not use behavioral advertising cookies.

s10.title: 10. Changes and Contact
s10.body: This policy may be updated. Contact your organization administrator or DPO for privacy questions.
